project.title: Real-Time Air Quality Monitoring Dashboard
project.shortDescription: A Laravel application presenting AQI on interactive maps with secure admin setups.
project.description: Developed an air quality monitoring dashboard with live AQI visualization and interactive maps. Implemented secure admin panel and testing workflows.
features: Interactive map overlays showing heatmaps of AQI zones.
Real-time feed integrations for AQI stations.
Administrative system to manually calibrate/override station reports.
Comprehensive unit testing suite achieving high coverage.
